description_en: Queries the URL of the web UI for a Spark application
kebab_example: aliyun adb describe-spark-code-web-ui --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-cluster-id amv-bp1v6usq6m650000 --job-id 1248 --api-version 2021-12-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeSparkCodeWebUi

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the cluster
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the AnalyticDB for MySQL Data Lakehouse Edition cluster.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/129857.html operation to query the IDs of all AnalyticDB for MySQL clusters within a region
parameters.help_zh:
<props="china">企业版、基础版或湖仓版集群ID。</props>
<props="intl">湖仓版集群ID。</props>

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Spark job

Message.description_en:
The returned message.

If the request was successful, SUCCESS is returned.
If the request failed, an error message is returned
